subject.title: fix(ios): trim model names in model picker

question: Should Apple chat model pickers continue displaying provider-qualified model IDs, or switch to gateway-supplied friendly model names?
rationale: The existing shared implementation deliberately renders `selectionID`; making the reported friendly-name behavior visible requires changing shared Apple UI semantics, not merely correcting iOS decoding.

options.title: Keep Qualified IDs
options.body: Close or narrow this PR because normalizing the unused `name` field does not alter the current picker contract.

options.title: Show Friendly Names
options.body: Change the shared `displayLabel` contract to use a normalized friendly name with a clear fallback, while preserving provider-qualified IDs for identity and selection.

recommendation.title: Keep Qualified IDs
recommendation.body: Close or narrow this PR because normalizing the unused `name` field does not alter the current picker contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current model-selector and display-label contract trace directly to this feature-introduction history.
